ChessGym uses crash reporting to detect and fix application errors. This data is used solely to identify crashes and improve app stability for all users. No personal information, game data, or usage patterns are collected — only technical crash details (such as stack traces and device model) when something goes wrong. You can change this setting later in the app.

string-array.name: loading_fact_bodies
string-array.item: Originally, the most powerful piece on the board was actually the weakest. The Queen could only move exactly one square diagonally. It was given its modern, unrestricted powers in 15th-century Spain, largely to honor Queen Isabella.
The second book ever to be printed in the English language (in 1474) was about chess. William Caxton translated a manuscript originally titled The Game and Playe of the Chesse.

The folding chessboard was invented by a priest who was forbidden by his religious order from playing the game. He made a clever workaround by folding the board in half and placing it on a bookshelf so it looked like two books.
While the longest grandmaster game on record lasted 269 moves, mathematics dictates a theoretical maximum game length in traditional chess of 5,949 moves without an automatic draw being triggered.

There has not been a single checkmate in a World Chess Championship match since 1929. The last one was in Game 8 between Alexander Alekhine and Efim Bogoljubov. Since then, all championship deciding matches have been won via resignation or time forfeit.
Early European chessboards actually featured monochrome (same color) squares, and it wasn\'t until around the year 1090 that the alternating light and dark square design was introduced.

The first game of chess played in outer space took place on June 9, 1970, between the Soviet Soyuz 9 crew and controllers back on Earth. The crew used a special set featuring pegs and slots so the pieces wouldn\'t float away in zero gravity.

The famous en passant (French for \"in passing\") pawn capture was introduced in Spain in 1280. It is one of the most frequently missed rules by beginners, largely because if you do not play it on the exact turn the enemy pawn moves, you permanently lose the ability to do so.
The word \"Checkmate\" comes from the Persian phrase \"Shah Mat\" (شاه مات). Surprisingly, it doesn\'t mean \"the king is trapped,\" but rather, directly translates to \"the King is dead\".

In 1973, police in Cleveland, Ohio, raided a chess tournament, arrested the tournament director, and confiscated the chess sets. They charged the organizers with allowing gambling (for cash prizes) and possessing gambling devices (the chessboards).

Effective date: May 2026 ChessGym ("the App") is developed by Paul Mihai Craciunas. This Privacy Policy explains what data is collected, how it is used, and your rights regarding that data. 1. Data We Collect • Account information: If you sign in, we store your display name, email address, and a unique user identifier via Firebase Authentication. • Gameplay data: Puzzle ratings, statistics, and achievement progress are stored to provide your personalised experience. • Crash and diagnostics: Firebase Crashlytics automatically collects device model, OS version, and crash stack traces to help us fix bugs. • Billing: Donation transactions are processed entirely by Google Play. We do not store payment details. 2. How We Use Your Data • To provide and personalise the App experience (ratings, achievements, progress sync). • To diagnose and fix crashes and performance issues. • To enable cloud backup of your progress when signed in. 3. Data Storage and Security Data is stored in Google Cloud Firestore with encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest. Access is restricted to authenticated requests only. 4. Third-Party Services • Firebase Authentication (Google) • Firebase Crashlytics (Google) • Google Play Billing We do not sell, share, or transfer your personal data to any other third parties. 5. Your Rights Under GDPR and similar regulations, you have the right to: • Access your personal data • Request correction of inaccurate data • Request deletion of your data • Export your data (data portability) • Withdraw consent at any time To exercise any of these rights, contact us at contact@chessgym.app. We will respond within 30 days. 6. Data Retention Your data is retained as long as your account exists. If you delete your account, all associated data is permanently removed within 30 days. 7. Children's Privacy The App does not knowingly collect data from children under 13. If you believe we have collected such data, please contact us immediately. 8. Changes to This Policy We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be reflected in the App with an updated effective date. 9. Contact For questions or data requests: contact@chessgym.app
